The ability is developed by analytical abilities, tolerant minds, wise decisions, and steady emotions. The vitality of the classroom, energy of the playing field, and an environment to reach one's full potential are stimulated by activities that value education, environment, health, games, sports, visual and performing arts, culture and heritage, and international experience, and are woven into the fabric of the school curriculum.

    Students succeed, countries prosper, and society gains. Equitable contributions as a learner, a member of the community, and a person spread the ideals of truthfulness, decency, and shared understanding in support of balanced economic growth in place of a healthy world.

    516:

    Our Approach to Polytechnic Education :

    517:

    The four pillars of the polytechnic educational paradigm are: technology-related education, experiential teaching techniques assessed on competency-based results, close linkages to industry, and applied research that aims to address issues encountered by industry and provide students with work-integrated learning (WIL). Its courses emphasise technology-based abilities.

    When compared to colleges, the most obvious distinction between our programmes is the degree to which our qualifications are relevant to the workforce. Our programs undergo annual reviews by a Program Advisory Committee (PAC), which advises Mansarovar Global University on curriculum development to fulfill our mandate from the Ministry of Advanced Education and Skills Development, ensuring alignment with emerging labour market needs. These yearly consultations give students confidence that their curriculum is consistently updated to reflect sector changes and that they are developing the skills required for meaningful employment.

    529:

    Basic Acknowledgement

    530:

    MGU is located on the traditional and treaty lands of Madhya Pradesh, in a region often referred to as Central India, along the Narmada River—a historical link between the northern and central parts of the country. Bhopal, now home to residents from various states, continues to serve as an important point of connection for all. Our respect for this land and the meaningful connections it calls for require thoughtful reflection, engagement, and action. This approach fosters relationships that are purposeful, moving us from mere acknowledgment to genuine connection.

    535:

    Work-integrated Learning (WIL)

    536:

    Applied research projects, co-ops, internships, field placements, and apprenticeships are just a few examples of educational and practical settings where students can participate in work-integrated learning (WIL). WIL addresses the common challenge of limited work experience among recent graduates by providing them with relevant industry exposure, which can enhance their prospects for future career opportunities. Through engagement in WIL, students strengthen their ability to communicate not only what they can contribute to an organization but also how they can achieve it effectively.

    537:

    Different WILs :

    538:

    Apprenticeship : A program that integrates classroom learning with practical on-the-job training.

    540:

    Co-op : A program designed or recognized by the institution that combines academic study with paid work experience.

    542:

    Applied Research Projects: Student-led projects aimed at addressing current challenges in the industry.

    548:

    Program Advisory Board (PAC)

    549:

    To ensure that all Mansarovar programmes remain relevant and aligned with industry needs, the Program Advisory Committee (PAC) meets at least twice a year. Each PAC evaluates every postsecondary degree, diploma, and certificate programme offered by Mansarovar.

    Membership in each PAC is voluntary and consists of eight to twelve external experts, including employers, alumni, industry and business leaders, and representatives from professional and accrediting bodies.

    The committee provides guidance on a range of key areas, including internships and field placements, employment opportunities, student honours and scholarships, curriculum development, technology integration, and public relations.

    550:

    The Program Advisory Committees play a vital role in maintaining the quality and strategic direction of Mansarovar’s programmes.

    561:

    Certifications Related to Employment

    562:

    Qualifications designed to develop competencies (skills) that are directly applicable in the workplace are referred to as employment-related credentials. By aligning the curriculum with industry requirements, students gain the specific skills that employers expect them to bring to their roles. Faculty collaborate closely with industry partners to identify the competencies students should demonstrate upon graduation and to design reliable assessments for tracking their progress.

    This approach differs from the traditional educational model by emphasizing the acquisition of industry-relevant skills and employing a variety of strategies to help students synthesize and apply their knowledge. Competency-based education, which allows students to progressively develop their abilities at their own pace, challenges the conventional one-size-fits-all approach to teaching and learning.

    570:

    The faculty is committed to leveraging their business expertise to deliver a comprehensive programme that aligns with evolving corporate expectations. By supporting students’ understanding of core concepts and learning objectives, and by creating an optimal learning environment, the teaching approach aims to bridge the gap between the classroom and the workplace. Through a diverse range of activities—including group discussions and collaborations, applied research projects, industrial exposure, and experiential learning initiatives—students and faculty work closely together to foster effective learning. The foundation laid by the faculty ensures that learning objectives are directly connected to industry needs through practical experimentation and application.

    575:

    Get to know 11 Mansarovar Global Univerrsity Faculties

    576:

    Mansarovar comprises 11 faculties, each renowned for their expertise and extensive industry and community partnerships. Our programs are delivered by instructors with substantial real-world experience, utilizing state-of-the-art facilities and innovative learning environments. Students have the opportunity to collaborate in multidisciplinary teams with faculty and partners, tackling real-world challenges while gaining valuable hands-on experience.

    583:
    587:

    At Mansarovar, we are dedicated to exhaustive quality learning and are utterly committed to a continuous process of improvement for the benefit of the students.

    597:

    About Group

    598:

    The University was established by Sri Sai Gramothan Samiti, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh. The society was founded in 1995 and has since been actively engaged in carrying out various projects and initiatives in rural and underprivileged areas to promote education and provide quality healthcare services. Over the years, the society has established a range of educational institutions in the fields of Dental, Nursing, Ayurveda, as well as CBSE-affiliated schools, all equipped with modern facilities and state-of-the-art infrastructure.

    Click to visit website 601:

    603:
  • To become one of the best institutes of the country committed towards value-based education, research innovation, knowledge-sharing, openness and entrepreneurial skills. 605:

    620:

    • 627:
